case.summary: This investigation was triggered by customer C02354 reporting that they never made the disputed $39.08 in-person transaction (ID 3491361), which occurred in billing region 126 alongside heavy transactional history across multiple regions. Case memory retrieved three similar confirmed fraud cases matching this out-of-region pattern, supporting a high fraud probability of 0.85. Because the customer explicitly denied the transaction, policy R2 requires blocking the card and creating a formal case file. Additional evidence was not requested since the direct customer denial satisfies the threshold for immediate enforcement actions under R2.

stop_reason: Fraud probability was extreme enough on initial evidence to act without further verification.
